derived.ingredients: parsed from description text (prepared items only: food, cocktails, mocktails); empty for wines/beers/spirits/plain beverages
derived.allergens: whitelisted allergen tokens from DB allergens field + contains-* tags
derived.dietary_tags: vegetarian/vegan markers from DB allergens field + metadata.tags.dietary
derived.cuisine: classified from category/subcategory (Japanese=sushi family, Italian=pasta, else South African; empty for drinks)
derived.keywords: tokens from item_name + category + subcategory + metadata.tags (protein/flavour) + cuisine
derived.image_filename: unique slug of item_name (.jpg) — target filename for AI image generation, not the current shared asset
derived.video_filename: unique slug of item_name (.mp4) — target filename for AI video generation, not the current shared asset
